name: tracking-lost
description: Still 1.5 s (pen down by dwell) -> stroke in progress for 1.5 s -> 1 s of null frames (no hand) mid-stroke at 3.00 s -> hand back elsewhere, moving for 1 s -> 0.5 s still (too short to re-arm a pen-down dwell). Expect the pen to lift > 300 ms into the loss and stay up after re-acquire.
